subject: Several Github packages failing to be found in deployApp

messages.author: 53626e29c26886b6
messages.subject: Several Github packages failing to be found in deployApp
parts:
When I deploy to shinyApps, several github-hosted packages fail to be found.

Example error message: 

Warning messages:
1: In FUN(c("shiny", "readr", "rCharts", "rbokeh")[[4L]], ...) :
  Package 'rCharts' not available in repository or locally
2: In FUN(c("shiny", "readr", "rCharts", "rbokeh")[[4L]], ...) :
  Package 'rbokeh' not available in repository or locally

Example packages that fail:
github.com/ramnathv/rCharts
github.com/timelyportfolio/materializeR
github.com/bokeh/rbokeh

The above have htmlwidgets in common, but I have had (intermittent) problems with other github-hosted packages (eg cellranger, googlesheets)

I  have disabled package cacheing and still failing.
Problems have occurred previously (a month or more ago) and recently. All packages that I can update have been updated.

Example (private) app that breaks: https://encharts.shinyapps.io/rCharts_test/

Any ideas?
